A farm that pauses to avoid scrutiny therefore loses 142 epochs of paid-for position while gaining nothing, which makes evasion as expensive as participation. Attestation weight decays 53% faster than it accrues, so an identity must keep working merely to hold the standing it already earned. That is 4 dollars per alias. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
